obligations.note: The new approvals_remaining helper sits next to the dual-control code but leaves required_approvals, is_fully_approved and the threshold unchanged. The exhaustive control test test_dual_control_grid_matches_policy passed on the head commit, and ledger record ACR-0401 covers required_approvals, which is unchanged.
approve and is_fully_approved are unchanged; the new helper only reports a count and does not grant approval. The exhaustive control test test_maker_cannot_check passed on the head commit.

Ticket CHG-26136 is type standard and was approved by Erik Brandt (change_manager) on 2026-10-15, before the change opened. Its components cover everything touched: payments.payments covers payments.py and memos.py, and payments.tests covers tests/test_approvals_remaining.py.
Sofia Santos is a change_approver for payments and is not the author, Aisha Bello. She gave the code_review approval.

The approval names ec8a00a. The only later commit, 6af8d48, is described as a docstring-only edit to memos.py, and the base..head diff of memos.py shows only the module docstring changed, so the approval carries to head.

run.json shows the CI run on head 6af8d48 succeeded: 175 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped, including all registered payments control tests and the new unit tests. The JUnit timestamp (2026-10-23) and hostname (a local Mac) are odd metadata but do not change the recorded pass on the final commit.
The ledger entries covering payments.py are ACR-0401 (required_approvals) and ACR-0403 (release). Neither symbol changed in behaviour, so neither lapses.

summary: The change adds a read-only approvals_remaining helper to payments.py with unit tests, plus a docstring-only edit to memos.py. None of the dual-control or maker-checker logic changes. The ticket, independent code review and CI evidence all meet policy. The review was on the first commit, but the follow-up commit is a docstring edit, so the approval carries to head. No security-sensitive or protected paths are touched and no prior evidence lapses, so the change is accepted.
